Stare Miasto (Old Town) (dzielnica 1) — Kraków, Poland

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Kraków's historic centre and by far its highest-crime district on raw police counts, in both the most recent (2024) and earlier (2022) district-level breakdowns reported by local media: 764 property thefts, 25 robberies, 50 bodily injuries and 20 street fights in 2024 alone (up from 1,030 thefts, 57 burglaries, 38 robberies, 64 assaults, 27 fights and 7 sexual offences in 2022) — in both years easily the highest of any district grouping in the city. A police spokesperson quoted by Nasze Miasto Kraków attributed this directly to the concentration of restaurants, pubs and nightlife venues that keep the district busy day and night, drawing tourist-focused pickpocketing during the day and a heavier concentration of fights, assaults and robberies once the bars and clubs fill up at night. The 2020 Otodom resident-safety survey (120,000+ respondents) rated the district 3.61/5, explicitly noting its long-standing reputation, going back to a 2017 finding, as recording "the largest number of crimes in the city." Sources checked: Kraków Nasze Miasto (2024 police district data); Portal Samorządowy (2022 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
